sources.label: Free-time patches for apps
sources.author: RabehX
patch_list: Removes the FLAG_SECURE screen capture block and disables Android 14+ screenshot detection callbacks so screenshots and recordings work everywhere.

Disables Expo OTA updates so patched JS bundles are not overwritten, removes Sentry crash/performance telemetry and root checks, and strips leaked debug tooling while keeping Firebase push notifications working.
Fixes dashboard buttons becoming disabled after resuming from the background.
Removes Google Play's PairIP anti-tamper wrapper, restores the original Application class, strips com.pairip.* components and CHECK_LICENSE, and neuters the license client.
Removes the diagonal student registration number watermark overlaid on screens.
